The '''EG-6 power droid''' by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] was an ambulatory [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Eg-6_Power_Droid.jpg|left|thumb|An EG-6 power droid]]
A [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]]<ref name="Cynabar">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]], the EG-6 was 1.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="TNEGtD" /> Outfitted with low [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]], EG-6's only function was to provide energy to diverse machinery, starships, and other vehicles. Most of the EG-6's interior was filled out by its [[Power fusion generator|fusion generators]]. Its hull was heavily armored, and the droid was designed to survive extreme temperatures or radiation.<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

There were two heavy power plug-in sockets on the right side of the EG-6's body and a standard power plug-in socket on the lower half of its front. There was also a light power plug-in socket in the face-like unit on the upper half of its front side, which also contained a system diagnostic package and visual sensors as well as an acoustic signaler. The droid was able to speak droid and computer languages only.<ref name="TEGtD" />

The system diagnostic package included a spectrometer and infrared, sonar, and X-ray scanners and was used for equipment checks. Although rarely used, the EG-6 had a manipulator arm that was hidden under a small panel on its lower front side.<ref name="TEGtD" />

==History==
[[File:EG-6_power_droid.png|thumb|left|150px|An EG-6 on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
The EG-6 was found nearly everywhere throughout the galaxy, but its lead in the energy-supply market diminished a bit when [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] released the nearly identical [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]].<ref name="TEGtD" />

[[File:Powerdroid_egtd.png|right|thumb|EG-6 schematics]]
Its follow-up model, the [[S9-series heavy power droid]], a larger and more powerful version of the EG-6, was Veril Line Systems' answer to the GNK droid.<ref name="VG8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp07.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 7: Land of the Jawas}}</ref>

The EG-6 that was owned by the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was several hundred standard years old.<ref name="VG8" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], EG-6 power droids were used by the [[Talusian Smugglers]] in their [[Smuggler Base|base]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Exploiting a Weakness|Talus}}</ref>

An EG-6 power droid was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. It was in the palace of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] came to the palace as part of the [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. It squealed in pain as [[8D8/Legends|8D8]], under the command of its supervisor droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], lowered a hot glowing iron on the soles of its feet.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' state that the power droid that C-3PO and R2-D2 found in the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Jawa sandcrawler]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] was an EG-6. However, this droid emits the "gonk" sound, which is a feature of the [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]].

A different version of the EG-6 can be seen in ''The Phantom Menace'', and it was often mistaken for the GNK power droid.
